generated.description: A tall, ornate baroque clock tower built mostly from sandstone and smooth quartz, with gray stained glass windows, spruce plank floors, and gold block accents. It stands about 80 blocks high on a 25 by 25 footprint, with a stepped base, a wide middle section, and a narrower top with a clock face and wool details. It is a decorative landmark with no block entities, so the inside is mostly open floors and ledges rather than working rooms.
